listed_quote.quote: Ares Capital Corporation (NASDAQ: ARCC) announced today that it has completed its previously announced acquisition of American Capital, Ltd. (NASDAQ: ACAS)

announcement.quote: ARES CAPITAL CORPORATION TO ACQUIRE AMERICAN CAPITAL, LTD IN TRANSACTION VALUED AT $3.4 BILLION

outcome_evidence.quote: ARES CAPITAL CORPORATION COMPLETES ACQUISITION OF AMERICAN CAPITAL, LTD.

deals.notes: Both are BDCs (American Capital withdrew its BDC election after the merger; Ares is called the largest business development company). Stockholders of both approved on 2016-12-15 (8-K filed 2016-12-16); mergers effective 2017-01-03 per the 8-K filed 2017-01-04. Consideration was cash plus Ares shares.
